Package com.stockly.persistence

Class JsonInventoryRepository

java.lang.Object
com.stockly.persistence.JsonInventoryRepository
All Implemented Interfaces:
InventoryRepository
public class JsonInventoryRepository extends Object implements InventoryRepository
Stores the inventory in a single human-readable JSON file.

Why JSON? It needs no database server and no external library, the file can be opened in any text editor (handy during a viva demonstration), and it is perfectly adequate for a small retail store.

Safety features:

  • Atomic saves - data is written to a temporary file first and then moved over the real file, so a crash in the middle of saving can never leave a half-written inventory.
  • Corruption handling - if the file cannot be parsed, it is renamed to inventory.json.corrupt-... instead of being overwritten, and the user is informed.
Author:
Umama Wahab
